name: Dyn_Body_GetMass
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_ship_inputs. float __thiscall(body), RET 0, ST0, body 00C31FC0-00C31FDC. Returns FLDZ when B+50h bit 0 is set (00C31FC1), otherwise 1.0f/M[+50h] through FLD1/FDIVRP and a float spill at 00C31FD5. CORRECTION to docs/UNIT_CONTROLLER_UPDATE.md, which calls it the inverse mass: M+50h is itself the INVERSE mass (00C37F40 stores 1/mass there at 00C37F53, and 00C41550 multiplies the force by it to get an acceleration), so this returns the MASS and the zero is the static-body guard against 1/0. 004462D0 uses it that way: force = 00C31FC0(body) * 10.0 * submersion / record[+1Ch]. docs/RIGID_BODY_INTEGRATION.md

name: Dyn_Profiler_ResetCounterTree
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_dyn_step, read-only analysis. __fastcall void(node), body 00C321B0-00C321E?, callers 00C5C540 at 00C5C586 and itself. Recurses over the node's children (array at node+4h, count at node+8h) and zeroes node+38h, node+3Ch and node+40h on every node it reaches. Those three dwords are exactly the accumulated tsc total (+38h/+3Ch) and the call count (+40h) every profiler scope's pop writes, so this is the per-frame reset of the profiler counter tree. 00C5C540 runs it over every child of the root at [[0109E9FC]+0Ch], zeroes the root's own three and bumps the frame counter at [[0109E9FC]+0Ch]+8h. docs/DYN_PHYSICS_SUBSTEP.md

name: Dyn_TaskScheduler_RunBatchAndWait
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_dyn_step, read-only analysis. void(count) with the scheduler in ECX/ESI and the task-pointer vector in EAX, body 00C33140-00C3324B. Call sites 00C5BB30 at 00C5BCCA (EAX = world+480h, the LCPSolver2Task pointers) and 00C5C0E8 (EAX = world+468h, the LCPSolverTask pointers), and 00C57070 at 00C577EE; ECX is [[0109E9FC]+10h] at all three. Enters the critical section at scheduler+18h, grows the pending vector at scheduler+0Ch (size +10h, capacity +14h) by count, writes the batch index into each task's +4h, releases the semaphore at scheduler+350h by count, records the batch size at scheduler+30h + batch*4, leaves the critical section and blocks on WaitForSingleObject(scheduler+1C0h + batch*4, INFINITE). A fork-join, so the caller is single-threaded again on return. docs/DYN_CONTACT_SOLVER.md

name: Dyn_ContactGroups_Clear
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_dyn_step, read-only analysis. An outlined block with the contact-group manager in ESI (the decompiler shows unaff_ESI), body 00C3F410-00C3F45?, called from 00C4B610 at 00C4B632 (ESI set at 00C4B630) and 00C4B550 at 00C4B5FF. Frees the manifold-pointer array of each of the manager+8h group entries (stride 0Ch) and then sets manager+8h and manager+10h to zero. With the manager at world+448h those are world+450h (the group vector's size) and world+458h (the group count the substep's solver partition reads), which is what makes the group list per-substep state. docs/DYN_CONTACT_SOLVER.md
